g.text: MinVelRank1Convo3 begins.
MomToxicated: Drifter. Can we talk?
G'morning, Minerva. If that is your real name.
We've dropped the "quotes", I see.
Now you're asking?
Yeah?
+5 Chemistry
MomToxicated: I was lectured about my so-called bedside manner.
+5 Chemistry
MomToxicated: Believe it or not, it is.
MomToxicated: Which is hysterical, all things considered.
MomToxicated: Right to the chase. Good.
MomToxicated: But that's not the point.
MomToxicated: We're here in Höllvania with a problem to solve. And you can help me solve that problem.
MomToxicated: So I need you - and this is me asking - to help me.
What is the problem I'm supposed to be solving?
Why should I help you?
And what does this have to do with Rusalka?
MomToxicated: That is a very good question.
MomToxicated: You don't have to want to help me for my sake. We have a common enemy. This "Man in the Wall."
MomToxicated: As far as I can figure, we're both interested in where he's gone, what he's after, and why he targeted Rusalka in the first place.
MomToxicated: Am I correct in that assessment?
Can you back up and take a minute to explain to me why you care about Rusalka so much?
For the first two, yeah. I don't actually really care two shits about why he went after Rusalka.
Sure. Yeah. That's correct.
MomToxicated: The why isn't important.
MomToxicated: If you aren't at least mildly interested in her well-being, why spare her life like we know you did? We heard the story.
I hate to break it to you, but we're probably stuck waiting until the Man in the Wall makes his next move.
PapaPolar: it is, though. and they've probably worked it out already, anyway. it's not like we're exactly subtle
Because then I'd have been no different than the Indifference. Than Scaldra. Than Entrati. I don't go around senselessly murdering people.
Because it wasn't really her making the choices that led her to that point. Just because I wouldn't kill her for it in the moment, doesn't mean I *care* enough to go out of my way to save her.
Because I wasn't about to do Entrati's dirty work for him. If he wanted to kill the Indifference's new puppet, he could do it himself.
MomToxicated: And why is that? You have no way of tracking him? It? Whatever it is? Or do you not know what it's really after?
PapaPolar: and maybe, *just maybe* if you trusted our new lil buddy here with a little bit of information, they might be more willing to *heeeeelp uuuuuus*
Which implies that I purposefully murder people. Which I don't. I mean. I do kill people. But it's different. You know what I mean.
I didn't *know* her.
But just as I suspected, the old bastard only likes to shoot people he knows will get back up.
Can't exactly slap a tracking beacon on a demigod-god-thing, no.
His motivations are a bit lost on us at the moment, yeah. But it's nothing good.
PapaPolar: it's almost like that's how people work sometimes.
+5 Chemistry
PapaPolar: and we're not exactly giving you a reason to care. are we, M?
PapaPolar: a very oddly specific statement but okay
MomToxicated: So you're suggesting we sit. And wait. For it to... what. Pop its head up? And we play a round of Whack-A-Weasel?!
MomToxicated: What good would it do?
PapaPolar: you're talking to a pair of ex-military special ops, we get it. lol
MomToxicated: Shut it, Velimir.
It's fine. I die a lot. I'm used to it.
It doesn't really matter.
PapaPolar: at least this place has good company and a nice bar?
PapaPolar: doesn't hurt to have friends in this world, M.
PapaPolar: what we have to do in the name of the "greater good" gets blurry sometimes
PapaPolar: oookie dokie... sure, lil buddy... sure...
Why are you so desperate to learn what happened to Rusalka?
PapaPolar: music is pretty good. that arthur guy seems like my kinda drinking buddy
MomToxicated: What do we need "friends" for?! We'll be out of here as soon as we know where we need to be to save Neci.
PapaPolar: which is why, when we can do something that matters, we do it. which is why we're here trying to save neci
PapaPolar: anyway...
MomToxicated: And, what, we just go on with not knowing what's really happened to her?! Or if she's okay?! Or if she's really her anymore?!
PapaPolar: dunno about that. seems like it's gonna be hard to predict the movements of a demigod void monster... thingy. amirite, lil buddy?
MomToxicated: How can you sit there and be OKAY with that, Velimir?!
PapaPolar: i never said i was okay with it, M! i just understand when we have to sit and bide our time!
MomToxicated: I've talked to Eleanor. She told me what she felt when she touched Neci's mind. Or what was left of it.
MomToxicated: The woman we raised. The woman we loved as our own.
MomToxicated: Who knows what -
MomToxicated: And you want to talk about drinking with Arthur.
MomToxicated: Du-te dracu, Velimir.
PapaPolar: aaaaaand she's off...
What'd she say...?
Gonna guess that was rude language.
PapaPolar: joy of having been stationed on so many overseas ops. getting cussed out in 100 different languages
PapaPolar: yeah. joy of having been stationed on so many overseas ops. getting cussed out in 100 different languages
Are you two... married?
You two... raised... Rusalka?
Update boolean MinervaVelimir1
Update boolean MinervaNeci3a
PapaPolar: mmm. kinda. not really anymore. on paper only. somewhere. in some country that stopped existing circa 1982?
PapaPolar: more or less. we were overseas in a lil town a few countries south of here. place got blown to bits. found her there in a building, all red hair and aaaaaangry.
PapaPolar: does that count?
PapaPolar: she tried to stab me six times with a spoon bahahaha cutest lil thing you've ever seen.
Yeah, doesn't seem like you two are still together.
That explains the arguing I guess.
PapaPolar: had this little stuffed rabbit toy she was clinging to, though. M told her she'd protect it with her life 'n keep it safe.
PapaPolar: what gave it away.
PapaPolar: when neci left to go join scaldra... things weren't ever the same between us. it was the last straw, i think.
PapaPolar: that got neci's trust real fast. ran right for M and threw her arms around her. we quit the military then. well. officially. became "consultants."
PapaPolar: sigh.
PapaPolar: so... yeah. you could say we raised her.
PapaPolar: alright, gotta go do what i do best.
PapaPolar: pretend i know what i said wrong and pretend i'll not screw up again like that in the future.
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank2Convo1.
